section_1_presentation_and_advisory.name: Strategic Delivery & Value Articulation
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.criteria: Delivers a compelling, narrative-driven walkthrough of the user experience framed around customer personas and operational impact. Explicitly justifies why the architecture directly solves the root business problem (avoiding a 'science project') and presents a viable Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) model that demonstrates fiscal responsibility.
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.successes: 100% unified unit-economic and monthly TCO math across ARCHITECTURE.md and slides.md: $20.90/mo ($0.209/1k queries) for Gemini 2.5 Flash Default vs $102.90/mo ($1.029/1k queries) for Tiered Pro Synthesis, explicitly pricing Firestore 2 reads + 1 write per-comparison telemetry ($0.30/mo) and 10x Black Friday traffic burst sensitivity ($229.00/mo at 1M queries/mo).
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.failures_and_gaps: Trade-off boundary: At >10M monthly comparisons, pay-as-you-go Vertex AI token pricing becomes less cost-effective than Provisioned Throughput (GSUs), requiring an automated FinOps reservation trigger in Phase 3.
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.reasoning: Score 3 (Expert): All unit-economic tables across ARCHITECTURE.md and presentation slides are reconciled with exact per-component cost math, Firestore operation billing, and 10x burst sensitivity modeling.

section_1_presentation_and_advisory.name: Objection Handling & Technical Defense
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.criteria: Remains entirely calm, collected, and collaborative under pressure when facing stakeholder resistance. Confidently defends engineering decisions and structural design choices during the Q&A matrix using data-backed logic, while cleanly evaluating and addressing technical trade-offs (e.g., cost vs. latency, model tiering).
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.successes: Preempts CISO, CTO, and CFO objections with empirical p95 latency breakdowns, separates SQL injection parameterization from LLM prompt-injection defense (sanitize_user_prompt + ModelArmorConfig), and evaluates single- vs multi-node trade-offs.
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.failures_and_gaps: Heuristic regex sanitization in sanitize_user_prompt remains vulnerable to semantic paraphrase or base64 obfuscation if Model Armor API is unreachable.
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.reasoning: Awarded Score 3 (Expert) over Score 2 for data-backed executive objection defense and explicit separation of database vs LLM security controls.

section_1_presentation_and_advisory.name: Presentation Skills & Time Management
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.criteria: Paces the presentation to finish on time. Tactfully steers the panel away from rabbit holes, offering to take tangential topics offline without being dismissive. section_1_presentation_and_advisory.successes: Provides a structured slide-by-slide executive presentation deck (docs/presentation/slides.md) with speaker notes, verifiable SKU demo flows, and explicit out-of-scope enterprise boundaries (no live cart checkout or ERP mutations).

section_1_presentation_and_advisory.name: AI Driven Development Discussion
section_1_presentation_and_advisory.criteria: Articulates how their harness was set up before coding. Demonstrates understanding of establishing key guidance that enables both 'in the loop' (quick feature fix that adheres to spec) and 'outside the loop' (goal driven - task is taken and executed in a loop through lint, test, etc. until goal is passed) development. Incorporates mistakes by the agent/harness back into agent instructions.
